notes.title: Relax Mode, Custome Menus and more! Huge update arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey Chefs!

We have very good news! The new Cooking Simulator VR update is ready and... it's big! We are introducing things like Relax Mode, Custom Menus, and a lot of other things! This, of course, is not the end of our work on the game. Expect more updates and big DLC in the future.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added new game mode - Relax mode! In this game mode, the time of the day flows as usual, but guests' orders have time limits removed, allowing you to take your time and take everything at your own pace. When loading an old save file, you will be prompted to choose whether you want to play the Classic Mode or the Relax Mode
[*] Skipping day ahead of time - after half a day has passed, you can choose to skip the rest of the day and cancel existing orders without penalty, so experienced players can progress faster in the early game
[*] Filtering recipes in laptop view and Custom Menu view by recipe name, ingredients, or event type
[*] Clicking the empty mop holder will summon the mop to it, and clicking it again will pick the mop up
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved area of maneuver when using spices/liquids on products
[*] Fixed bug causing end game view to not display awards earned during contests
[*] Fixed products not changing their texture when applying heat
[*] Fixed pouring sound not stopping after the jar/bottle is broken
[/list]

If you like the game, leave a review! It helps us a lot!

You are more than welcome to join our Discord server - https://discord.gg/dERxD78

Best,
Gameboom VR Team

notes.title: Patch 1.06 is here! Physics, fixes and… firecrackers?
notes.notes:
Hi Chefs!

Time for another game update! This time we focused on the physics fixes and your submissions.

In Cooking Simulator VR 1.06, a new, more precise mechanic for grabbing objects awaits you. At the same time, we improved the rotation of objects on the spatula and improved cutting. It should work even better.

We also haven't forgotten a few things you asked for. Radio now have a button that allows to "Shuffle" your custom playlist and firecrackers now blows up due to chain reaction. Some of you really like to destroy this kitchen...

The full changelog is below:

- Oculus Quest 2 droping items delay has been fixed
- Added completely new and precise remote grab mechanic
- Fixed disappearing fragments while remote grabbing (trigger + grab)
- Fixed disappearing fragments while multipicking (trigger + main hand thumbstick up + grab)
- Improved flipping products with spatula
- Fixed problem with flipping products over pans
- Improved cutting mechanics
- Fixed "blunt" knives problem
- Fixed knives stuck into a products
- Products bought via tablet with container in one hand will spawn inside of it
- Improved products physics while transfering them from one container to another
- Radio shows volume percentage now
- Radio now have a button that allows to "Shuffle" your custom playlist
- Containers will not colide with movables on hooks anymore
- Fixed products leaving containers by themselves after loading saved game
- Spieces/Timers can be hold in any container while we move (works with any rotation/movement mode)
- Spatula/Tongs and other movables can be hold in any container while we move (works with any rotation/movement mode)
- Bottles can be hold in any container while we move (works with any rotation/movement mode)
- Containers can be hold onto another containers while rotating/moving with snap/teleportation
- Resolved problem with snapping pots with items inside to the stove
- Fixed problem with closing oven beneath the stove
- Gloves boxes will return automatically now when thrown out through the window
- Fixed rare problem with remote grabbing oven trays
- Fixed rare problem with missing active knife slot in knives stand
- Fixed problem with clipping objects into another objects on snap spots
- Fixed snapping containers to different stove spot than selected one
- Fixed problem with cup blender blending products next to/over the cup
- Various Cooking School mode UI fixes
- Fixed rare products weight bug
- Fixed dart board UI bug
- Radio knob rotation is much smoother now
- Improved two holded products/items collisions whithin Snap rotation mode
- Broken bottle fragments grabbed remotely lays properly in both hands now
- Radio grabbed remotely lays properly in both hands now
- Products fragments grabbed remotely lays properly in both hands now
- Problem with switching hands near a hook while holding spatula has been fixed
- Problem with switching hands near a stand while holding knife has been fixed
- Fixed improper broken glass highlight bug
- Fixed strawberries/brussels model while holded with steady hands perk active
- Reactivated perk Fairy Touch respawns the wand in a same place
- Disabled Slow Motion perk has been removed from Career mode
- Saved games now displays actual time spent during gameplay
- Basic pan has been added to Career mode start kitchen equipment
- Jars and boxes displays now how many pieces have left (cinnamon sticks, pasta etc.)
- Hints has been added for products activated with trigger (f.ex. egg, scallion)
- Firecrackers now blows up due to chain reaction
- Firecrackers and candles can be lightened now with stove and blowtorch fire
- Flipped jars dont loose all it content at once anymore
- One of the Halloween event (decorations) recipies has been moved to be more visible
- Various SFX fixes (on-load, broken bottles, dart board collision, buttons effects etc.)
- Various collisions fixes (pork shoulder, baking tray stand, knives, ladles, stacks etc.)
- Various menu UI fixes and addons
- Various translations corrections
 
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/dERxD78
 
Thanks again and enjoy the cooking!
 
GameBoom VR Team

notes.title: Patch 1.05 is here! Dart game, custom music, tunneling
notes.notes:
Hi Chefs!

We've recently updated the game focusing on fixes. This time we're also introducing some new content!

Let's start with a new mini-game added to the kitchen! You will find a dart game near the microwave! Of course, you will throw knives at the target! Now you can use the trigger to turn the knife in your hand so that it is easier to throw. Pro tip: it's a bit easier to throw knives in slow-mo.

Radio. Yes, we hear you. Lots of people have reported wanting to add their own music to Cooking Simulator VR, and we're excited to announce that it's now possible. You can upload your .mp3 files or... enter the URL for internet radio!

In addition, we added the tunneling option to prevent motion sickness, made it easier to pick up plates full of dishes, changed the appearance of strawberries, eggs or brussels, and made it possible to open the bottles with one hand.

The full changelog is below:

Added knives dart game board :)
Knives can be flipped before a throw (trigger)
Added custom music radio stations - check in-game Settings -> General section
Added custom internet radio stations - check in-game Settings -> General section
Added tunneling vision option - check in-game Settings -> VR section
Fixed bug with delivering soup in Career tutorial
Fixed remote grab pointer sliding of the item
Fixed products behavior after loading a saved game
Fixed Halloween cauldron disappearing after loading a saved game
Products won't fell off from remotely grabbed containers that easy now 
Improved altered grabbing settings (Inverted/Toggle)

Various visual improvements (Ghost items, shaders, fire effects, render layers, etc.)
Various physics improvements (Collisions, slots, joints, etc.)
Fixed problem with scrolling UIs with a slightly damaged thumbstick
Strawberries/Eggs/Brussels models has been changed
Bottles can be now opened with one hand while holded (trigger)
Fixed bug with remotely grabbed containers position
Fixed fluid layers in containers
Fixed problem with fireproof food rack
Fixed poured liquids SFX


Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/dERxD78

Thanks again and enjoy the cooking!

notes.title: HTC Vive wands hotfix available on beta branch. Instructions inside.
notes.notes:
Hi Chefs,

First of all, big thanks for such a warm reception. It means so much to us and gives our work a reason, because we are making games for you to enjoy! There will be bigger news with thanks and sum up since this is just a few hours after release and the reason for this announcement is different.

Some players reported to us that they have issues while using Vive controllers. At first, we weren’t able to reproduce it, but we found that after the latest driver update controllers are no longer recognized properly hence the issues. We have already prepared a patch, but until we fully test it it will be available only on the Steam beta branch. Of course it’s available to all of you, so if you have issues with Vive controllers just use a beta branch.

Here are the instructions on how to download beta and fully enjoy the game!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iinz4mDvJK0

Are we fast? Yes.
Are we eager to solve any of your issues as fast as possible? Hell yes!


Best,
Gameboom VR Team

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We know how long you wait for the game to be released and what your expectations are.
We don’t feel good about the delays and we work very hard to make up for your waiting and provide you with a great and polished game.

We implement every piece of feedback we get from beta testers and currently we wait for the game to be accepted by our Publisher and Oculus Store (since we want to release on both stores at the same time). When we get the approval, I’ll come straight to you with the good news and solid release date. For now, we have to postpone it at least (and hopefully) to April.

To end the news on a positive note I’ll present you a feature many of you asked before.
It took some additional time and resources to do so, but we believe it was worth it.

The hands are no longer vanishing. What's more, you can grab objects exactly where you want and the hand intelligently poses itself even on irregular pieces of cut food!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gBof0eV2Bc8

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: New Gameplay Video / Beta Sign-Up / Release info. Sign-up closed. Keys sent.
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We are here today with the new gameplay video showing the progress of our game. We are continuously working on Cooking Simulator VR and we feel that the time has come to open up for community input. But, before we go into the details… let’s make some soup!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sVTVqVEjP-Y&feature=youtu.be

We are now mostly focused on polishing and bug fixing, but we also want to hear from you - what you think about the game now and what has to be added for the release. We need a bit of time to gather and implement your feedback and that’s why we plan to release the game in Q1 2021. We believe that it will be a much better product if we apply community feedback and it’s worth taking that additional effort.


If you are excited (as we are!) about the game and want to try Cooking Simulator VR and help us, we have good news - we have just opened registration for Beta Phase 2. You can register using this form:
[Registration closed] 

Currently we plan to limit this phase of beta to 500-700 players, but you’ll get email from us regardless whether you qualified or not. If you fill the registration form expect an email around 17.12.2020 (probably in the Promotion tab, or some other weird place in Inbox) and that’s when the Beta Phase 2 is scheduled to start.

Edit:
We planned to email everyone, but we got over 3000 applicants and hit limit on emails we can send, so we sent message only to the ones who got into beta.
There rest of applicants will be considered again for Phase 3 after New Year.
